status_meaning: Measurement only. 'pass'/'fail' here is the harness's reading of the literal mechanical condition; it is not a V verdict, not E evidence and not acceptance. Visual criteria are outside this harness.

q_sample_canvas.check: The candidate file is exactly 32 x 32 pixels, the canvas of the sample contract c_sample, and contains zero fractional-alpha pixels under that contract's binary alpha. Scope: the representative sample only; the canvas is a sample-scoped controlled-evaluation confirmation and the alpha policy an observation from the references, neither a confirmed project policy.

q_sample_palette.check: Every visible pixel of the candidate is one of the three colours of the sample contract c_sample palette, #56B5BC, #F4DDA2 and #25354A, with no colours outside it. Scope: the representative sample only; these are the colours measured in the references, all three admitted by the sample-scoped outlined-treatment confirmation, and exclusivity is a sample working rule that a later role accent may reopen; this is not a confirmed project palette.

additional_measurements_not_in_any_saved.note: f_sample plans a single static sprite; a multi-frame file would be a cardinality question for import, not a q_sample_canvas failure.
